st: The Girl Who Came To Dinner
d: Home alone on the houseboat one evening, Maya is surprised by a visit from Mike. He asks where her sister Kendra is.
An action episode dealing with an ecological theme near and dear to the hearts of ocean lovers everywhere - the systematic pollution of the seas.
While out on a cruise recording Flipper and Aphrodite's clicks and whistles. Pam and Keith spot a disables boat.
Diving at a coral shelf, a buzzing sound catches Keith's attention. The slinky beauty who swims nearby gets even more attention from him.
At the dolphin Institute, Aphrodite swims about the lagoon as Keith uses his echolocation transmitting device to emit clicks and whistles to her.
The new weekly series takes place in and around the Bal Harbor Institute, a marine mammal research facility set in the beautiful Florida Keys.
